notes.title: Pre-Alpha next version, it will need at least 2 weeks
notes.notes:
Hello,
i'm working to start advertising the game on lots of platforms.
So after that will be finished, i will continue to go ahead with the next version of the Pre-Alpha Demo.

The idea is to send a new one here on Steam, on Itch.io, on Game Jolt and on IndieDb, in the next 2 or 3 weeks. This to be certain to clear lots of bugs that have arisen and to let people talk and share the game to build awareness.

Most bugs verified concern movements and parkour behaviours, like the wall climbing for example. I think that will need a lot of work...



Do not want to grab more time from you, so when we will arrive near the date... i will alert.

In the meantime, have a good day you all and check out the Pre-Alpha Trailer on YouTube, if you want.

Obviously you are free to share thougths and suggestions to improve the game and the whole experience.



https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sqdvRnJ_Jbg
